steps.output:
def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    upper = grid[:sep]
    lower = grid[sep+1:]
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in upper for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    counts = Counter(x for row in lower for x in row)
    rare = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    return [[3 if x == rare else bg for x in row] for row in lower]
